title: VHSRip instance
description: Per-template schema for vhs. Core TemplateConfig fields (theme/global) are $ref-d from the global animations.schema.json. This template does NOT own content — it applies a full-frame worn-tape CRT treatment to arbitrary `children` passed by the caller, so `elements[]` is unconstrained (any id) and typically empty. extras.* are extended here.

elements.description: Currently unused by vhs itself — content is passed as `children` to <VHSRip>. Kept in the schema for DeepConfig pipeline compatibility.

speed.description: Playback speed of the tape artifacts. 1 is normal speed

wave.description: Strength of the slow horizontal tape wave

jitter.description: Strength of the fine per-line horizontal jitter

crease.description: Strength of the travelling tape crease band

switching.description: Strength of the head-switching noise at the bottom

switchingHeight.description: Height of the head-switching band as a fraction of the screen

bloom.description: Strength of the horizontal glow bleed (expensive — 11 texture taps/pixel)

aberration.description: RGB channel misalignment in CSS pixels

acBeat.description: Strength of the slow brightness beat rolling down the frame

scanlines.description: Intensity of the CRT scanline overlay

barrel.description: CRT tube curvature bending the frame inward. 0 disables. Requires an opaque background in the wrapped scene for the bezel color

saturation.description: 1 keeps the content's colors, 0 is grayscale

exposure.description: Extra brightness multiplier applied at the end
